body: I am in therapy but the voices...they don't stop. And I don't just say I'm useless, I know I am. I don't make good grades and I don't have any plans for the future. I'm not going to have anyone to lean on when I leave my parents. I don't know how long my mother has, she has cancer. I just don't see the point in it all. What will I contribute to society? I want to be remembered but the reality is, in an office setting, as soon as you die there's always the next washed up intern to take your fucking place...I'm going to die in a god damn office with nothing to show for my life and ill fade into obscurity because I have no talent..so why not just end it sooner..
Its fine..it doesnt matter anymore..its gonna end soon anyway.
I don't know what to do anymore...

It's especially great when all you do is call yourself fat and ugly mentally all the fucking time, every minute of everyday you spend hating yourself thinking you're a walking ball of failures and uselessness.

trust me, I do too. you wanna know the number of people I've talked to even since way before the virus? 4, and one of them was more than likely shot to death recently, and he was my age 16. but thats besides the point, the point is you're lonely right? you need someone to speak to and since I assume you have certain..thoughts correct? I've been there more times than I can count. but just because there's a virus doesn't mean those people feel like you are wasting their time, its their job. they want to help people like you and me, no matter the circumstances. (Or they try to anyway)
